name: demo-playwright-javascript-for-google-search
summary: A beginner-friendly Playwright + JavaScript demo that describes driving a real browser against the real, live Google Search website. Must never be run against live google.com in CI or automated tooling.
description: This demo describes using Playwright and JavaScript to drive a real Chromium browser to https://www.google.com and run three real assertion-based checks: the home page title, the results page title after searching "testing examples", and that clicking the first result link navigates away from google.com. Written from documented knowledge of Playwright's API and Google's well-known, stable accessible markup rather than live verification, because Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of its services.
